anchor.quote: Let $W$ be the number of wires in the network
Let $s$ be the total number of smaller calls that one call makes
The parameter $\ell$ counts the selected axes
An edge runs from a tail label $U$ to a head label $U'$
Let $\mu$ be the sum of the dimensions of the source labels
let $L$ be the total dimension lost along decreasing edges
Let $\gamma(\ell)$ be the cost of a call at parameter $\ell$ divided by its volume.

gaps.quote: each on one role stream of $V/W$ bits
gaps.note: The page never says what a role stream is or how it relates to a role.

gaps.quote: so every role stream holds the same volume $V/W$
gaps.note: The splitting procedure is missing (the text reads 'To split an array,,,'), so the reader cannot check that every role stream gets volume V/W.

gaps.quote: because all incidences of one gate carry the same label
gaps.note: Incidence of a wire at a gate is not defined on the page.

gaps.quote: The total is the sum over all edges:
gaps.note: The formula after the colon is missing, so the reader cannot see what is summed.

gaps.quote: since the labels are nested, its rank is the absolute change
gaps.note: The definition of edge rank is cut off ('Its rank is,'), and the page does not justify why nested labels make the rank equal |Delta|.

gaps.quote: so the signed sum of all $\Delta$ is $Wm-2\mu$
gaps.note: The argument about sources, sinks and terminals is missing (the text reads 'What remains is the terminals:,'), so the reader cannot check the signed sum.
The step from the per-edge rule to the total is garbled ('So, and the total is'), so the reader cannot check the sum.

gaps.quote: The complex construction gives $s=Wm-2\mu+2L$, as states.
gaps.note: The complex construction is never introduced on this page, and 'as states' points to no statement the reader has.

gaps.quote: The bit construction has, giving $s=Wm-\mu+2L$, as states.
gaps.note: The bit construction is never introduced, and its derivation is missing ('has, giving').
The result is attributed to an unnamed paper and not proved or linked, so the reader cannot check 2L < mu, which the bound s < Wm depends on.

gaps.quote: Dividing by volume, So, ignoring the linear work
gaps.note: The division that gives gamma(m l) about (s/W) gamma(l) is missing (the text reads 'Dividing by volume, So,'), so the reader cannot check it.
